name: hob-agent
description: Claude Code as one of hob's agents: on the household board under its own name, to hand work off to Codex, musecode, or another session and pick it up again. Every call goes through hob's sentinel.

url.title: hob's URL
url.description: Where hob answers, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://hob.example

key.title: An agent's hob key
key.description: This agent's own key, not a person's: bin/rails "hob:agent[claude-code,household]". Kept in the keychain.
